description: This file implements an AES encryption driver for the Lantiq platform, including hardware interaction, request queuing, and multiple cipher mode support (ECB, CBC, CTR, RFC3686). It registers cryptographic algorithms, manages a request queue, and interfaces with hardware registers for AES operations.

classes.name: aes_ctx
classes.description: Structure holding AES key length, key buffer, and nonce for RFC3686 mode.

classes.name: aes_container
classes.description: Structure for managing AES request context, including buffers, mode, flags, and request info.

classes.name: lq_aes_alg
classes.description: Structure representing a registered AES algorithm.

methods.name: lq_deu_aes_core
methods.description: Main interface to hardware for AES encryption/decryption, sets up hardware registers and initiates DMA transfer.

methods.name: count_sgs
methods.description: Counts the number of scatterlist entries needed for a total byte size.

methods.name: lq_sg_init
methods.description: Initializes scatterlist buffers for source and destination.

methods.name: lq_sg_complete
methods.description: Frees AES container memory after processing.

methods.name: aes_container_cast
methods.description: Casts ablkcipher_request to aes_container pointer.

methods.name: process_next_packet
methods.description: Processes the next packet or scatterlist segment for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: process_queue
methods.description: Tasklet to trigger processing of queued requests.

methods.name: aes_crypto_thread
methods.description: Thread handling AES requests, manages request dequeuing and hardware interaction.

methods.name: lq_aes_queue_mgr
methods.description: Manages queuing of AES requests, handles request segmentation and enqueuing.

methods.name: aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets the AES key in the context.

methods.name: aes_generic_setkey
methods.description: Wrapper for setting AES key.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets key and nonce for RFC3686 mode.

methods.name: aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypt request handler.

methods.name: aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypt request handler.

methods.name: ecb_aes_encrypt
methods.description: ECB mode encryption handler.

methods.name: ecb_aes_decrypt
methods.description: ECB mode decryption handler.

methods.name: cbc_aes_encrypt
methods.description: CBC mode encryption handler.

methods.name: cbc_aes_decrypt
methods.description: CBC mode decryption handler.

methods.name: ctr_aes_encrypt
methods.description: CTR mode encryption handler.

methods.name: ctr_aes_decrypt
methods.description: CTR mode decryption handler.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_encrypt
methods.description: RFC3686 mode encryption handler, sets up counter block.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_decrypt
methods.description: RFC3686 mode decryption handler, sets up counter block.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_aes_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers AES algorithms.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_aes
methods.description: Unregisters AES algorithms and cleans up.
